summary: Impulse-candle indicator marks bars with body of at least ATR times a multiplier, minimum body ratio and close location, optionally confirmed by tick volume.
claim: Impulse candles can be formalised with fixed rules instead of visual identification.

rules.timeframes: Defaults target M1-M15 on volatile symbols
rules.entry: Arrow on a bullish impulse bar (green, below) or bearish impulse bar (red, above); EAs read shift 1
rules.indicators: ATR(InpAtrPeriod), body ratio, close location, tick volume average
rules.filters: Optional tick volume above InpVolumeMult times the average of the prior InpVolumePeriod bars
rules.conditions: Body >= ATR x InpImpulseAtrMult; body >= InpMinBodyRatio of range; close in top/bottom segment per InpMinCloseLoc; active bar can repaint until it closes; buffer 0 bullish, buffer 1 bearish

relation_to_sentinel: Partial complement: momentum-bar definition could feed an entry gate; no stop, exit or trend filter; thresholds are named inputs only.

summary: Stormbreaker ADX EA on H4 combines Supertrend ATR(10) factor 3.0 with ADX(14) at or above 23 and +DI/-DI; exits on ADX below 18 or reversal.

rules.entry: Buy: bullish Supertrend, ADX >= 23, +DI > -DI; Sell: bearish Supertrend, ADX >= 23, -DI > +DI; evaluated once per new bar on the previous bar's values
rules.exits: ADX < 18, Supertrend reversal, or an opposite qualifying signal; no fixed take-profit
rules.sizing: 0.5% equity risk via OrderCalcProfit against the proposed stop, rounded to broker steps with margin check

relation_to_sentinel: Overlap: trend-direction and strength gates with ATR-derived stop; no fixed target or +1R trail, exits by ADX and Supertrend reversal.
